purpose: Constructed v1/v2 pair for ACP2 plugin upgrade and historical read-only access (A-23).
notes: Both distributions are synthetic fixtures; they validate a fixed native single-point JSON record and never run a QC program.
The wheels are built and installed only in an isolated virtual environment by tests/test_acp2_science_plugin_gate.py.
v1 and v2 keep the same distribution and capability names; v2 changes the plugin version, capability schema version, recipe reference and validator reference.
The checked-in v1 artifact under artifacts/ was produced by the v1 fixture in that isolated environment and is labelled constructed.
